metadata.title: AI RMF Tier 2 Customer-Facing Profile (community example)

parties.name: ai-rmf-oscal-catalog community contributors
parties.remarks: Community contributors to the ai-rmf-oscal-catalog project. Not produced by, endorsed by, or affiliated with NIST.

metadata.remarks: Tier 2 — Customer-facing worked example. Selects 55 controls (Tier 1 plus 37 additions). Designed for AI systems whose outputs reach external customers or end-users. Adds controls for fairness and bias evaluation, explainability and interpretability, privacy risk, accountability and transparency, post-deployment monitoring, continual improvement, third-party accountability, and external feedback mechanisms. Excludes specialised controls that are contextually specific (e.g., environmental impact MEASURE 2.12, deep third-party contingency GOVERN 6.2, unknown-risk recovery MANAGE 2.3, human-subjects-protection MEASURE 2.2). This is a worked example, not a normative baseline. Released under CC0 1.0. Not endorsed by NIST.

resources.title: AI RMF community OSCAL catalog (v0.4)
resources.description: Resolves to the v0.4 catalog generated by src/generator.py from this repository. Two rlinks are provided: the canonical HTTPS URL on GitHub for production use, and a relative filesystem path for local validation runs.
resources.remarks: First rlink is preferred when validating from outside this repository. Second rlink works when validating from inside the repo (relative to profiles/).
